purpose: Strict ratchet for the automatic public-fixture regression gate. It records what was MEASURED on the public upstream test demo; it is not a statement about the real A9.1 demo and it authorizes nothing.

divergenceNotes.grenades: Row counts differ between the Python wheel and the WASM build of the same pinned commit only for non-grenade entity classes (CC4, CKnife, CWeaponGlock): upstream keeps deleted projectile entity ids in a set that later, reused ids still match. The nine grenade/projectile classes are equal. Resolving this is a versioned contract change that needs owner approval; it is deliberately NOT hidden here.
divergenceNotes.game_state: Composite domain that includes the grenade table; diverges only because grenades diverges.

syntheticScale.note: Row count and input size of the real A9.1 demo as recorded in run #24/#25 public reports; rows are synthetic.
